title: agrimonia eupatoria subvar. albiflora
intro: Agrimonia eupatoria subvar. albiflora, commonly known as White Agrimony or White Clover Agrimony, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral activities, which can help in treating various health issues like wounds, infections, and fever. The therapeutic actions of White Agrimony include astringent, diuretic, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating conditions like diarrhea, coughs, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
